description: S3 bucket with no server-side encryption configuration
note: Fires many other S3 rules too; only the encryption pair is expected here. Trivy deprecated aws-s3-enable-bucket-encryption (AWS-0088) once AWS began encrypting S3 by default; AWS-0132 (customer-managed key) is what fires on a bare bucket and is the Trivy-side twin of CKV_AWS_145.
